request.deadline: 12 months; grant period begins after closure of the existing contract
deliverables: Part-time maintainer for Pallas over 12 months
Essential codebase maintenance including dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, and documentation
Community support including issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback enhancements, and public communication
AI-friendly documentation and integration resources for AI-driven development workflows
Milestone-based disbursement controls through Intersect treasury management smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Pallas by TxPipe maintenance for Year 2 over 12 months, including Intersect administration.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve, with a total on-chain withdrawal of 540,750 ADA including a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee.

Pallas is described as a collection of Rust crates implementing Cardano and Ouroboros primitives including CBOR, cryptography, networking mini-protocols, ledger traversal, transaction building, and address handling.
The proposal states that Pallas is used by Aiken, Dolos, Lucid, Oura, Mithril, Amaru, UTxO-RPC, and other ecosystem projects.
The document claims Pallas has over 649 pull requests, 199 stars, 91 forks, 60 contributors, and 214,446 crates.io downloads, with links to GitHub and crates.io.
The proposed maintainer work covers maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal asserts that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal asserts the requested withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
The document states independent oversight will be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, with reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
Treasury funds will be managed through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with specified TRSC and PSSC addresses, role thresholds, oversight entities, and a public dashboard.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month continuation of Pallas maintenance by TxPipe, submitted by Intersect, with stated ecosystem usage, governance-process approval, NCL compliance, smart-contract custody, oversight, and milestone-based disbursement controls.
